title: Injective module sheaf augmentation on a ringed-site hypercover
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small subcanonical site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]; subcanonical means that each presheaf $h_V(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(T,V)$ is a sheaf. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $I$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the abelian category $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ of sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $W$ be an object of $\mathcal C$ and let $U_\bullet\to W$ be an augmented simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object], with augmentation commuting with all simplicial operators. Assume it is a hypercover: $h_{U_0}\to h_W$ is an epimorphism of sheaves of sets, and for each $p>0$ the map $h_{U_p}\to M_p$ is an epimorphism, where $M_p$ is the finite limit of the lower-degree representable sheaves giving compatible proper faces of a $p$-simplex over $W$. Define $C^p(U,I)=I(U_p)$ for $p\geq0$, zero for $p<0$, with differential $\delta^p=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j d_j^*$ and $R(W)$-module structure through $U_p\to W$. Then the canonical restriction augmentation $I(W)[0]\to C^\bullet(U,I)$ is a quasi-isomorphism of complexes of $R(W)$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Explicitly the augmented sequence $0\to I(W)\to I(U_0)\xrightarrow{\delta^0}I(U_1)\xrightarrow{\delta^1}I(U_2)\to\cdots$ is exact. No weak contractibility or affineness of the $U_p$ is assumed.
